evidence.title: NorForge describes human-set goals and agent blackboard coordination across exposed Cairn panels.
evidence.observation: NorForge describes human-set goals and agent blackboard coordination across exposed Cairn panels. It checked a live uploader shell and one large-retailer chain.
evidence.limitations: The roughly 10% success rate is explicitly an assumption; model identity is inferred from worker labels. Successful-task duration averaged under 23 hours, not an intervention-window measure. Separate victim cases remain distinct within this campaign grouping.
evidence.open_questions: Underlying raw traces and all alternatives have not been independently checked by the Commons.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed bounded finding; publication inclusion does not certify truth or completeness. Do not count Reuters, CSA or secondary reporting as independent confirmation; their scale claims derive from this investigation. Not the later harness-takeover campaign. No identical source/case in baseline v0.4.1; repeated media/report references merge to this source/case rather than independent corroboration.
evidence.dispute_status: Bounded correction checks; known limitations retained, no absence guarantee
evidence.verification_status: Not independently verified by the Commons

terms.name: Constraint compression
terms.definition: A reduction, often AI-enabled, in the practical barriers of knowledge, expertise, labor, cost, time, or coordination that once limited an activity. It describes the change in constraints, not the eventual impact of the activity.

terms.name: Cross-system feedback
terms.definition: A pattern in which an action or output from one technical or organizational process affects activity elsewhere and subsequent responses modify conditions for additional participants. Many response paths may exist; there need not be a single linear loop.

terms.name: Investigative indicator
terms.definition: An observed characteristic or combination of signals that provides a reason to investigate a possible event, mechanism, or hidden relationship without establishing that it occurred.
